answer: Every identity in the agent economy must lock a bond before acting. The bond sits in shared escrow, a lagoon of collateral no fake account can dodge. When detection spots clones voting in lockstep, it slashes them and seizes the deposit for honest participants. An attacker aiming for the zenith of influence pays that cost on every clone, so a hollow swarm of identities becomes ruinous. The attack collapses under its own duplication.
